description_en: Calls the ModifySslVpnClientCert operation to modify the name of an SSL-VPN client certificate
description_zh: 调用ModifySslVpnClientCert接口修改SSL-VPN客户端证书的名称
kebab_example: aliyun vpc modify-ssl-vpn-client-cert --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --ssl-vpn-client-cert-id vsc-bp1n8wcf134yl0osrc0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifySslVpnClientCert

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

The client generates the value of this parameter. Ensure that the value is unique among different requests. The value can be up to 64 ASCII characters in length.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId of each API request is different
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the SSL-VPN client certificate. 

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
SSL-VPN客户端证书所在的地域ID。 

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the SSL-VPN client certificate
parameters.name: ssl_vpn_client_cert_id

parameters.help_en:
The new name of the SSL-VPN client certificate. This parameter cannot be empty.

The name must be 1 to 100 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh:
SSL-VPN客户端证书的新名称。该参数不能为空。

长度为1～100个字符，不能以`http://`或`https://`开头
parameters.name: name

Name.description_en: The name of the SSL-VPN client certificate

SslVpnClientCertId.description_en: The ID of the SSL-VPN client certificate
